title: Benefit Overpayment Accounts — Waiver Points for Part-Time Work While Certifying
content:
On Benefit Overpayment Accounts, points are added to the waiver share for a claimant still working part time while certifying, judged on the claim the overpayment arose from (the claim named on the overpayment record, held among the claimant's Unemployment Benefit Claims) over the certified weeks ending in the employment window before the handling date.

## The two conditions

- **Earnings on every recent certified week**: at least one certified week on that claim ends in the employment window of 1 month (whole months from the week ending date to the handling date fewer than 1), and every one of those weeks reports gross earnings above zero.
- **Claim still active**: the status of that claim is active.

## Points

| Earnings on every recent certified week | Claim still active | Points added to the waiver share |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | 0.1, the working-and-claiming points |
| Yes | No | 0.05, the working-or-claiming points |
| No | Yes | 0.05, the working-or-claiming points |
| No | No | None |

## Desk points

- A single recent certified week reporting 0.00 earnings means the first condition is not met, whatever the other weeks report.
- With no certified week ending in the employment window, the first condition is not met.
- Weeks certified on another claim are not looked at.
- *Hypothetical:* handling date 20 June; the overpayment's claim is active and has certified weeks ending 23 May, 30 May, 6 June and 13 June, each reporting earnings. The week ending 23 May is less than one whole month before 20 June, so all four weeks count; both conditions are met and 0.1 is added.
